title: Purification of His-tagged membrane proteins from detergent-solubilized membranes
protocol: Prepare solubilized membranes according to the protocol using frozen membranes from a 1 l culture.
Solubilize membranes in 1% DDM, 20 mM Tris-HCl (pH 8.0), 300 mM NaCl, 10% glycerol, and 0.01% NaN3 for 2 hours at 4°C under gentle agitation.
Ultracentrifuge the solubilized mixture at 100,000g for 50 minutes at 4°C.
Dilute the supernatant two-fold with washing buffer (20 mM Tris-HCl (pH 8), 300 mM NaCl, 0.04% DDM, 5 mM histidine, 10% glycerol, and 0.01% NaN3).
Bind the diluted supernatant to Ni-NTA Superflow beads for 2 hours at 4°C.
Load the beads onto a gravity flow column (Wizard Midicolumn, Promega).
Wash the column with washing buffer (20 ml).
Elute bound protein with washing buffer containing 200 mM histidine.
Collect eluted fractions (e.g., 250 μl fractions) and identify those containing purified target protein by SDS-PAGE.
Purified protein can be used for SPA-binding experiments after removing histidine using desalting columns.
